Verifiable.NET: compile-time formal verification toolchain for C# (.NET 9 / .NET 10) with 100% type-safe contracts.
Packages: Verifiable.Contracts (runtime attributes, Spec.*, & immutable unions, net9.0;net10.0), Verifiable.Generators (TypeAlias<T>, Refined<T>, InboundPort source generators, netstandard2.0), Verifiable.Analyzers (Gatekeeper VER001-006, Linear Checker VER007, Z3 SMT Prover VER101-104, netstandard2.0), Verifiable.CodeFixes (VER001/002/004/005/006 Roslyn fixes, netstandard2.0), Verifiable.Testing (GalaxyCheck + SQLite fault injection, net10.0).
Guides: README.md (user guide) and docs/manual.md. Set VERIFIABLE_AGENT=1 and GALAXYCHECK_AGENT=1 for deterministic, structured JSON agent output.

== Quick Start ==
1. Install Z3 once:
   Windows: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install-z3.ps1
   Linux/macOS: bash scripts/install-z3.sh
2. Declare type-safe constrained types (`readonly partial record struct` + `public static bool IsValid(T)`):
   [TypeAlias<int>] public readonly partial record struct TodoId { public static bool IsValid(int v) => v >= 1; }
   [TypeAlias<decimal>] public readonly partial record struct PositiveAmount { public static bool IsValid(decimal v) => v > 0m; }
3. Seal domain logic at the highest level (`[assembly: Verifiable]` or class/struct `[Verifiable]`) and write type-safe `Spec.*` / `[Invariant]`:
   [Verifiable]
   public static class LedgerEngine
   {
       [InboundPort]
       public static Account Deposit(Account account, PositiveAmount amount)
       {
           Spec.Ensures<Account>(result => result.Balance == account.Balance + amount);
           return account with { Balance = account.Balance + amount };
       }
   }
4. Build & test in agent mode:
   VERIFIABLE_AGENT=1 GALAXYCHECK_AGENT=1 dotnet test Verifiable.NET.sln -c Release

== Contracts & Hierarchical Scopes (Verifiable.Contracts) ==
No string expressions! All specs are checked by the C# compiler and stripped from IL via [Conditional("VERIFIABLE_SPEC")].
[Verifiable] (Assembly | Class | Struct | Method): seals scope with build Errors (VER001-006) and Z3 SMT proofs (VER101-103). Cascades assembly -> types -> methods.
[Unverifiable] (Class | Struct | Method): opts a type or method out of an enclosing [Verifiable] / [VerifiableCandidate] scope (nearest attribute wins).
[VerifiableCandidate] (Assembly | Class | Struct | Method): incremental migration mode; Gatekeeper emits Warnings instead of Errors.
[TypeAlias<TUnderlying>] / [Refined<TUnderlying>] (Struct): generates constrained `readonly partial record struct` from `public static bool IsValid(TUnderlying)`.
[Invariant] (Method | Property): marks a parameterless `bool` instance method/property as a type invariant proved by Z3 and checked at [InboundPort] gates.
Spec.Requires(bool): precondition proved at callers via Occurrence Typing and checked at runtime by [InboundPort] wrappers (when leading in method body).
Spec.Ensures<TResult>(Func<TResult, bool>) / Spec.Ensures(bool) + Spec.Result<TResult>(): postcondition proved on all returns and assumed by modular callers.
Spec.LoopInvariant(bool): inductive loop invariant placed directly inside `while`/`for`/`foreach` body (supports multiple/nested loops).
Spec.Decreases(int/long): non-negative termination ranking expression strictly decreasing per loop iteration.
[CheckedArithmetic] (Assembly | Class | Struct | Method): enables 32/64-bit BitVec overflow verification in Z3 for int/long arithmetic.
[MustConsume]: marks linear obligation struct that must reach a [ConsumesObligation] sink, return, or Obligation.Discard on every CFG path.
[ConsumesObligation]: marks method as a terminal obligation sink for [MustConsume] parameters.
[InboundPort]: generates Raw<T> DTOs, <T>Gate.TryMarshal, and <Class>Port.<Method> boundary wrappers.
[Ghost]: marks proof-only specification members excluded from generated Raw DTOs.
[PureAxiom]: marks trusted BCL/generator intrinsic whose contracts are assumed without analyzing body.
Result<T, TError>: `Result<T, E>.Ok(v)` / `Result<T, E>.Fail(e)` with `.IsSuccess`, `.Value`, `.Error`.
MarshalResult<T>: `MarshalResult<T>.Ok(v)` / `MarshalResult<T>.Fail(violations)` with `.IsValid`, `.Value`, `.Violations` (`ImmutableArray<ContractViolation>`).
Obligation.Discard(token, "reason"): explicitly discharges a [MustConsume] token on failure/abort branches.

== Source Generators (Verifiable.Generators) ==
[TypeAlias<T>] (`*.TypeAlias.g.cs`) & [Refined<T>] (`*.Refined.g.cs`) emit:
  - `[Verifiable]`, `[JsonConverter(typeof(NameJsonConverter))]`
  - `public|internal readonly partial record struct Name(TUnderlying Value) : IComparable<Name>`
  - `[PureAxiom] implicit operator TUnderlying(Name alias)` for seamless widening without `.Value` noise
  - `[PureAxiom]` relational operators `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=` (numeric/char), `ToString()`/`ToString(format)` helpers, `Length` (on `string`)
  - `[PureAxiom] From(value)` (with `Spec.Requires(IsValid(value))` + `Spec.Ensures<Name>(r => r.Value == value)`), `TryFrom(value, out result)`, `MarshalResult<Name> TryFrom(value)`, `TryMarshal(value, fieldName)`
  - `JsonConverter<Name>` with `ReadAsPropertyName`/`WriteAsPropertyName` so `ImmutableDictionary<RefinedKey, V>` serializes via System.Text.Json.
  - Zero-based bounded ints in `IsValid` (`v >= 0 && v < N` or `v is >= 0 and < N`) also get `UpperBoundExclusive` and `[PureAxiom] ReadUnchecked<T>(ReadOnlySpan<T>)`.
[InboundPort] generates `*.Gate.g.cs` and `*.InboundPort.g.cs`:
  - Recursively maps constrained types -> underlying primitive, `ImmutableList<T>`/`ImmutableArray<T>`/`ImmutableHashSet<T>` -> `List<RawT>`, `ImmutableDictionary<K,V>` -> `Dictionary<RawK, RawV>`, records -> `Raw<Type>`.
  - `<Type>Gate.TryMarshal(Raw<Type>? raw, string path = "")` validates leaf `IsValid`, enums, nested gates, and all `[Invariant]` bool methods/properties.
  - `<DeclaringType>Port.<Method>(...)` marshals all parameters and evaluates leading `Spec.Requires(...)` before calling the domain method.

== Diagnostics Reference ==
Every diagnostic message ends with a `Fix:` instruction.
VER001 (Error/[Verifiable], Warning/[VerifiableCandidate]): Mutable class, non-readonly struct, settable property, ref/out parameter, or member assignment. Fix: use `readonly record struct` or immutable `record` with `init;` and `with` expressions.
VER002: Mutable collection (`List<T>`, `Dictionary<K,V>`, `HashSet<T>`, `T[]`). Fix: replace with `ImmutableList<T>`, `ImmutableDictionary<K,V>`, `ImmutableHashSet<T>`, `ImmutableArray<T>`.
VER003: Unchecked `default(T)` or parameterless `new T()` on `[Invariant]`/`[TypeAlias<T>]`/`[Refined<T>]` struct. Fix: use `T.From(...)`, `T.TryFrom(...)`, or `[InboundPort]`.
VER004: Ambient authority (`DateTime.Now`/`UtcNow`, `DateTimeOffset.Now`/`UtcNow`, `Guid.NewGuid()`, `Random`, `Stopwatch`, mutable static fields, `Environment.*`, `Console.*`, `System.IO.*`). Fix: pass explicit deterministic parameter (`UnixTimestamp now`, `Guid id`).
VER005: Disallowed control flow (unannotated loop without `Spec.LoopInvariant`/`Spec.Decreases`, `goto`, `async`/`await`/`Task`, `lock`, `throw`, `try`/`catch`). Fix: annotate loop or return `Result<T, TError>`.
VER006: Unverified method call, `System.Reflection`, `dynamic`, or unanalyzed delegate invoke. Fix: mark callee (or its enclosing class/assembly) `[Verifiable]`/`[PureAxiom]`, or split via Sandwich I/O.
VER007 (Always Error across all methods): Dropped, overwritten, double-consumed, or unconsumed `[MustConsume]` token on any CFG path. Fix: pass to `[ConsumesObligation]` method, return it, or call `Obligation.Discard(token, reason)`.
VER101: Invalid or unsupported expression in `Spec.*`, `IsValid`, or `[Invariant]` (including mismatched `Spec.Ensures<T>` type argument or loop spec outside loop). Fix: use supported C# boolean, arithmetic, string, pattern, or immutable collection expressions.
VER102: Z3 found a counterexample (`SAT`) breaking `Spec.Requires`, `Spec.Ensures`, `[Invariant]`, `IsValid`, `Spec.LoopInvariant`, `Spec.Decreases`, `[CheckedArithmetic]`, or collection bounds.
VER103: Z3 returned `unknown` or timed out. Fix: simplify contract, add `Spec.LoopInvariant`/`Spec.Decreases`, or factor helper lemmas.
VER104 (Warning): Z3 executable not found; SMT proof checking skipped. Fix: run `scripts/install-z3.ps1` / `scripts/install-z3.sh` or set `VERIFIABLE_Z3_PATH`.
VER201: `[TypeAlias<T>]` or `[Refined<T>]` applied to type not declared `readonly partial record struct`. Fix: change to `public readonly partial record struct Name { public static bool IsValid(...) => ...; }`.
VER202: Missing or invalid `public static bool IsValid(T value) => ...;` method on `[TypeAlias<T>]` or `[Refined<T>]` struct.

== Agent Mode & Counterexample JSON ==
VERIFIABLE_AGENT=1 (or MSBuild `-p:VerifiableAgent=1`) emits single-line JSON inside `VER102` diagnostics:
  <verifiable-counterexample>{"rule":"VER102","symbol":"Type.Method","kind":"Postcondition","contract":"Spec.Ensures<decimal>(...)","counterexample":{"param":"val"},"smtHash":"abc123def456","fix":"Fix: ..."}</verifiable-counterexample>
GALAXYCHECK_AGENT=1 runs GalaxyCheck properties deterministically (seed 0) with concise <galaxycheck-failure> JSON blocks (`counterexample`, `csharp`, `replay`, `seed`, `rerun`, `Fix:`).
GALAXYCHECK_SEED=n overrides the property test seed.
VERIFIABLE_Z3_PATH=/path/to/z3 overrides Z3 binary discovery (search order: VERIFIABLE_Z3_PATH -> build_property.VerifiableZ3Path -> .tools/z3 -> ~/.verifiable/z3 -> PATH).

== SMT Subset (Verifiable.Analyzers.Smt) ==
Sorts: `int`/`long`/`enum`/`Guid` -> `Int` (or `BitVec 32`/`64` under `[CheckedArithmetic]`), `decimal` -> exact `Real` rational, `bool` -> `Bool`, `string` -> `VerStr` (null + `str.len`), `Nullable<T>` -> `Opt<T>`, records/`[TypeAlias<T>]`/`[Refined<T>]`/`Result<T,E>` -> `declare-datatype`, `ImmutableDictionary<K,V>` -> `Map(Array K V, Array K Bool, count)`, `ImmutableList<T>`/`ImmutableArray<T>` -> `Seq(Array Int T, count)`, `ImmutableHashSet<T>` -> `Set(Array T Bool, count)`.
CFG lowering inspects bound `IOperation` trees directly for `Spec.*`, `[Invariant]`, and `IsValid`, tracking Occurrence Typing path conditions, implicit widening, recursive property patterns (`{ Length: >= 1 and <= 200 }`), `with` expressions, `&&`/`||`/`?:`/`switch`, modular callee `Spec.Requires`/`Spec.Ensures`, and inductive `Spec.LoopInvariant`/`Spec.Decreases`.
Queries are SHA-256 cached in memory and `%TEMP%/verifiable-smt-cache-v1`.

== Automated CodeFixes (Verifiable.CodeFixes) ==
- HoistAmbientAuthorityCodeFixProvider (VER004): extracts `UtcNow`/`NewGuid()` into method parameter and updates call sites.
- FreezeMutableStateCodeFixProvider (VER001/VER002): converts mutable classes/structs to immutable records with `init;`, rewrites property assignments to `with`, swaps `List`/`Dictionary`/`HashSet`/`T[]` for `System.Collections.Immutable`.
- SandwichIoSplitCodeFixProvider (VER006/VER005): extracts pure middle slice between `await`/I/O calls into a `[Verifiable]` static core method.
- ExceptionToUnionCodeFixProvider (VER005): rewrites `throw` branches into `Result<T, string>.Fail(...)` / `.Ok(...)`.

== Testing with GalaxyCheck (Verifiable.Testing) ==
`VerifiableGen.PositiveInt`, `PositiveDecimal`, `NonEmptyString`, `CurrencyCode`, `NonEmptyGuid`, `Refined<TRefined, TUnderlying>`, `PortRejectsInvalid`.
`FaultInjectedSqliteHarness`: WAL-mode isolated SQLite harness with `PersistenceFaultKind` (`None`, `PreCommitCrash`, `PostCommitCrashBeforeAck`, `DuplicateDelivery`).
`DifferentialPersistenceProperty.Create`: wraps `GalaxyCheck.Stateful.StatefulProperty.Create` to verify SQLite durability and `[InboundPort]` round-trip parity against pure `[Verifiable]` models.
